switches.summary: Silent linear five-pin mechanical switch with 63.5 gf published bottom-out force and 3.5 mm total travel.

sources.label: Wuque Studio WS Switch Series product page

specification.note: Wuque publishes WS Silent Linear as a five-pin silent linear switch with 3.50±0.3 mm total travel, 63.5 gf bottom-out force, a 15 mm single-stage spring and factory lubrication. No actuation-force value is published on the cited product page, so Atlas leaves actuationForce unset.

switches.summary: Silent tactile five-pin mechanical switch with 63.5 gf published bottom-out force and 3.5 mm total travel.

sources.label: Wuque Studio WS Switch Series product page

specification.note: Wuque publishes WS Silent Tactile as a five-pin silent tactile switch with 3.50±0.3 mm total travel, 63.5 gf bottom-out force, a 15 mm single-stage spring and factory lubrication. No actuation-force or tactile-peak value is published on the cited product page.

switches.summary: Linear Haimu-manufactured mechanical switch with full-POM housings, a UPE stem, 60 gf published maximum bottom-out force and 3.5 mm total travel.

sources.label: Wuque Studio WS Morandi product page

specification.note: Wuque identifies Haimu as the manufacturer and publishes a linear switch with POM top/bottom housings, UPE stem, 18 mm double-stage spring, 3.50±0.3 mm total travel and 60 gf maximum bottom-out force. Atlas does not infer an actuation force from the bottom-out specification.

switches.summary: Factory-lubed linear mechanical switch with 30 gf published minimum preload, 58 gf maximum bottom-out force, 2.0 mm pre-travel and 3.5 mm total travel.

sources.label: Wuque Studio WS Pearl product page

specification.note: Wuque publishes WS Pearl with 30 gf minimum preload, 58±10 gf maximum bottom-out force, 2.0±0.5 mm pre-travel, 3.5±0.3 mm total travel, factory lubrication and 500 million-cycle durability. Atlas stores the published preload as initialForce and does not treat it as actuation force.
